page.notes: The first line runs on from the previous page, so the first paragraph is marked as a continuation. The small-caps name GUILHEL-MO LUDOVICO is set in capitals with the vowel u written as U. The printed line "illustriGubernatoreD." has no spaces in the original type; I have added them. "uno .Guberna-" has a stray full stop in print; I have left it out. "cum" on the eighth line is uncertain, so it is marked [?].
